payload.text: {"summary":"Verified and finalized the aomi-app-ux-tool-maker curation of apps/geckoterminal (price-oracle/DEX-analytics archetype, public API, no auth). The app ships 11 user-centric tools distilled from the spec's 20 endpoints: geckoterminal_list_networks (networks + per-network DEX ID discovery), geckoterminal_get_trending_pools (global or per-network, 5m/1h/6h/24h windows), geckoterminal_get_top_pools (network- or DEX-scoped, volume/transactions sort), geckoterminal_get_new_pools, geckoterminal_search_pools (symbol/pair/address → pool address resolution), geckoterminal_get_pool (single/multi address dispatch with buy-sell volume breakdown), geckoterminal_get_pool_ohlcv (day/hour/minute candles, USD), geckoterminal_get_pool_trades (last-24h trades with min_volume_usd whale filter), geckoterminal_get_token (composite: token profile + top pools in one call), geckoterminal_get_token_price (batch spot prices, up to 30 addresses), and geckoterminal_check_token_safety (GT score, honeypot flag, holder concentration, mint/freeze authority). Deliberately dropped endpoints: /networks/{network}/tokens/multi (redundant with batch pricing), /networks/{network}/pools/{pool_address}/info (overlaps token info), /tokens/info_recently_updated (global feed, no user story). Tools hydrate JSON:API relationships via include=base_token,quote_token,dex so the LLM sees symbols/DEX names instead of bare IDs; generated client types are trimmed of UI-only fields (no image_url/logoURI). PREAMBLE is domain-specific (~30 lines: role, capabilities per tool, network-slug/string-numeric/rate-limit conventions, tool-chaining workflow guidance, USD formatting rules) and reconciled against the shipped tool list. Verification: cargo build clean (cdylib libgeckoterminal.dylib produced), coverage cross-check of all 20 spec operations done, and a live API smoke against https://api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2 confirmed the base URL, JSON:API shape, and string-encoded numerics match tool assumptions. test.json is seeded with the happy-path story: 'Show me the trending pools on Base right now, then deep-dive the top one: its current price, 24h volume and liquidity, and any recent trades over $10k.' Edits stayed scoped to apps/geckoterminal (client is app-local under src/client/, so no ext/ changes were needed) plus the root Cargo.toml workspace-exclude entry.","changedFiles":"apps/geckoterminal/src/tool.rs; apps/geckoterminal/src/lib.rs; apps/geckoterminal/src/client/client.rs; apps/geckoterminal/src/client/mod.rs; apps/geckoterminal/openapi.yaml; apps/geckoterminal/openapi.preprocessed.yaml; apps/geckoterminal/openapi.meta.json; apps/geckoterminal/Cargo.toml; apps/geckoterminal/Cargo.lock; apps/geckoterminal/test.json; Cargo.toml (workspace exclude entry for apps/geckoterminal)","followUps":"Run /aomi-app-e2e-tester geckoterminal to expand test.json into a full multi-turn TDD spec and run the e2e harness. Optionally smoke-chat via aomi-run apps/geckoterminal/target/debug/libgeckoterminal.dylib to sanity-check tool naming and PREAMBLE wording against a live LLM. The public API is rate-limited (~10 calls/min); if the app sees real traffic, consider wiring a CoinGecko paid-plan key via the /onchain endpoints as a future auth variant. Two token-info response fields (gt_score_details, holders) remain untyped Maps from additionalProperties — aomi-build tighten-spec with captured samples could type them if the safety tool's output needs firmer structure."}
